title: .fleetlint.yaml
description: Repository policy for fleetlint. Everything is optional; the whole policy lives in this one file.

catalog.description: Use another version of the fleetlint catalog than the one built into the binary, for the fleetlint: presets and the fix templates. It is fetched once with git and cached.

version.description: A tag or a full commit SHA of the catalog repository. A commit cannot move; a tag can.

repo.description: The catalog repository (https or ssh). Default: https://github.com/fleetlint/catalog.git

sources.description: A sources file mapping the names `org` and `team/<name>` to catalog references: a local path, https://…#sha256-<digest> or git+<url>//<path>@<tag or commit>. With it, extends resolves in the fixed order presets, org, teams, repository.

extends.description: Catalogs in order; later entries override earlier ones field by field. Presets: fleetlint:minimal, fleetlint:recommended, fleetlint:strict, fleetlint:oss, and the add-on fleetlint:slop. Remote: https://…#sha256-<digest>, git+<url>//<path>@<tag or commit>, or oci://<registry>/<repository>:<tag> (signed; signers in the sources file) or @sha256:<digest>. Local: a file or directory path. Names from the sources file: org, team/<name>.

scopes.description: Sub-directories evaluated as their own repository. Omit to discover workspace members; [] disables scopes.

match.description: Glob against the finding's path, or re:<regex> against its message. Omit to cover every finding of the rule.

until.description: YYYY-MM-DD; after this date the finding returns at full severity.

baseline.description: Path of the baseline file (default .fleetlint-baseline.json). Findings listed there report as baselined; the file only shrinks.

container.description: Where the task runner's targets run. none: on the machine. devcontainer: in the repository's dev container (the default when a devcontainer.json exists). docker / podman: in an image run with that engine. fix writes the runner file and the check workflow for the chosen value.

taskrunner.description: The task runner to check and to generate for. Unset: the first one found (Makefile, justfile, Taskfile, Gradle, package.json scripts); make when there is none.

rules.description: Keyed by rule id. For a catalog rule: enabled, reason, severity, params, accept. For an inline rule: kind plus its definition.

reason.description: Required when disabling a rule or lowering its severity.
